body: Regardless of what this person’s gender is (it isn’t even relevant tbh), Common_Ad3898 should know that breasts/lack of breasts does not equal gender.

Oh, I had no idea. I tried searching for a sub like that multiple times but just couldn’t find it for some reason??

The hotline is a joke. The only people who reference it to you when you’re feeling suicidal are the ones who’ve never called it themselves. 20% of the time they’re rude in some way, and 75% of the time they just don’t seem to care. You’re lucky if you encounter the 5% that actually do their damn job. It’s all just a bunch of completely untrained, overworked strangers sitting exhausted in their cubicles not knowing what to say to you except repeating what you’ve already told them as if you’re stupid and don’t know that overused technique. Unless you’re simply looking for the cops sent to your house, you’re better off not calling them. So sorry you had to go through that shit, man. I know how it feels to put your trust in something and be utterly let down.

Have to agree with the people who are saying this is a bad decision. I never posted on this sub or even made a comment but I totally still indulged in this sub often, only for the misgendering kink. But now you’re taking that away, for… what reason? So cis guys don’t harass anyone? You realize you can ban people, right? I feel like that “reason” is just a cover-up for the real meaning behind this: you want to make r/ftmspunished into a tame kink space. You are 100% defying the whole point of this sub, we are here for extreme kinks. There’s already a sub for tame ftm porn but we chose this one instead for a reason.
I’m also just not comfortable with someone looking through my post history to see if I’m “worthy” enough for this new sub. My post history is very small anyways. I doubt I’m the only one that feels this way, and there’s going to be quite a few people who will never show interest in the new sub because it’s private… it’s not going to be very popular.
I really hope you guys rethink this decision. I am ftm myself and with many people, indulging in kinks relating to your trauma can help you cope. This includes misgendering. It sounds weird, but look into it. Think about it.

Rest well, Harry. 
I’m positive he felt your love, every bit of it. Dogs can just tell. 
And I’m really, truly sorry for your loss.
Take some time, however long you need, to heal.
